title.value: AB 1817, Ting. Product safety: textile articles: perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).
title.provenance: AB  1817,  Ting.  Product  safety:  textile  articles:  perfluoroalkyl  and polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFAS).

location.provenance: The people of the State of California do enact as follows:

date.provenance: [Approved by Governor September 29, 2022. Filed with Secretary of State September 29, 2022.]

pfas_definition.provenance: (e)  'Perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances' or 'PFAS' means a  class  of  fluorinated  organic  chemicals  containing  at  least  one  fully fluorinated carbon atom.

type.provenance: 108971. (a) (1)  Except  as  provided  in  paragraph  (2),  commencing January  1,  2025,  no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.

who.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state

action.provenance: no person shall manufacture, distribute, sell, or offer for sale in the state

products.provenance: any new, not previously used, textile articles that contain regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS

value: outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions (exempt until 2028)
disclosure required for outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions
exceptions.provenance: Paragraph (2) does not apply to outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions until January 1, 2028.  However, commencing January 1, 2025, no person shall distribute, sell, or offer for sale ... outdoor apparel for severe wet conditions ... unless it is accompanied by a legible and easily discernable disclosure

type.provenance: A manufacturer of a textile article shall provide persons that offer the product for sale or distribution in the state with a certificate of compliance stating that the textile article is in compliance with the requirements of this chapter and does not contain any regulated perfluoroalkyl and polyfluoroalkyl substances or PFAS.
